Optionally, anonymous usage statistics can be enabled via the cookie banner (opt-in); the operator must provide the required backend themselves. dsgvoRights: Your Rights as a Data Subject (Art. 15-22 GDPR)
dsgvoRightsText: Under GDPR, data subjects have the following rights against the data controller regarding their personal data:
dsgvoRightAccess: Right of Access (Art. 15 GDPR): You can request information about whether and what data is being processed about you.
dsgvoRightRectification: Right to Rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): You can have incorrect data corrected.
dsgvoRightErasure: Right to Erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): You can request the deletion of your data, provided no legal retention obligations apply.
dsgvoRightRestriction: Right to Restriction of Processing (Art. 18 GDPR): You can have the processing restricted.
dsgvoRightPortability: Right to Data Portability (Art. 20 GDPR): You can receive your data in a structured, commonly used format.
dsgvoRightObjection: Right to Object (Art. 21 GDPR): You can object to the processing at any time for reasons arising from your particular situation.
dsgvoRightWithdrawal: Withdrawal of Consent (Art. 7 (3) GDPR): You can withdraw your consent to storing your learning progress and to the optional statistics at any time, just as easily as you gave it. The lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal remains unaffected. To do so, open "Cookie settings" at the bottom of any page and switch the option off; switching off progress storage deletes the stored progress at the same time. You can also switch off Progress Tracking in the settings under "Privacy & Progress". "Reset all data" in the settings under "Data Management" withdraws every consent at once; the cookie banner then asks again.
dsgvoRightsContact: To exercise your rights, please contact:
dsgvoComplaint: Right to Lodge a Complaint with a Supervisory Authority (Art. 77 GDPR)
dsgvoComplaintText: Without prejudice to any other administrative or judicial remedy, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The authority responsible for this website is:
dsgvoContactText: If you send a message via the feedback form or by email, the data provided (message content, optionally an email address for reply) will be used exclusively to process your inquiry. Data will not be passed on to third parties. Data will be deleted after final processing, unless legal retention periods apply. Providing an email address is voluntary; without an address, however, no reply is possible.
dsgvoLocalStorageText: This site stores the following information exclusively locally in your browser (localStorage). It does not leave your device and is never transmitted to any server:
dsgvoLocalStorageCookiePrefs: Your consent decision from the cookie banner or the settings: whether you agreed to storing your learning progress and to the optional statistics.
dsgvoLocalStorageProgress: Your learning progress — which quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths you have completed — bundled in this single entry. It is created only after you agree to storing your progress; until then, progress is kept in memory for the current visit only, and if you decline, an existing entry is deleted.
dsgvoLocalStorageTheme: Your chosen design: style, light or dark, and accent color.
dsgvoLocalStorageLang: Your selected display language and whether the Plain Language view is active.
dsgvoLocalStorageFont: Your selected font — such as the accessible OpenDyslexic typeface.
dsgvoLocalStorageFeedback: Messages you send from the feedback page — including your name and e-mail address if you entered them (the 50 most recent at most). They stay in your browser; you can delete them on the feedback page at any time.
dsgvoLocalStorageMore: Further purely functional entries, also local only: your favorites and comparison list in the catalog, which news items you have already read, whether glossary terms are highlighted in texts, and your playground settings.
dsgvoLocalStorageTechnical: Technical entries that say nothing about you: which version of the site you last loaded (so an update can be detected) and a copy of your design's color values (so the page does not flicker while loading).
dsgvoLocalStorageNote: Deleting: in the settings under "Data Management", "Reset all data" removes every entry listed here in one click. The page then reloads and asks for your cookie choice again. Your feedback messages can also be deleted directly on the feedback page, and your browser settings ("clear site data") remove everything as well. The export function saves your learning progress, news read status, your favorites and comparison list in the catalog, and some settings to a file; design, font, language, and feedback messages are not included. When a new version of the site is released, your data and settings are kept — only technical caches are renewed.
